meta.name: BBC Drama Classics
meta.description:
Enter a world of timeless stories with BBC Drama Classics. From Austen, Dickens and the Brontës to beloved period dramas and literary masterpieces, rediscover the characters, romances and rivalries that have captivated generations.

Shows: The Durrells, Sense and Sensibility, Emma (2009), Upstairs Downstairs, Mansfield Park (1983)
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
